title: Reusable skills and task-story tooling
summary: Repaired video routing and portable skill resources; added canonical-story authoring, study-design guidance, story drafts, source-pinned export batches and mirror checks. The follow-up polish condenses repeated instructions and removes duplicate export bookkeeping while preserving evidence inspection and visual-acceptance boundaries. Catalogue migration remains a separate 13/205 checkpoint.
decision_provenance: The user requested a latest-work survey and skills/scaffolding proposals, then instructed make repairs and complete the expansion. The assistant completed the proposed workflow tooling under that direction and kept the separate 205-entry content migration explicit. The user then requested simplification, polishing, cleanup and a commit. No medical execution, acquisition or publication is included.
reopen_when: A real invocation exposes a workflow gap, a source or recipe contract changes, or the user selects the separate remaining catalogue-content expansion.
